basic_details.job_title: RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram (RCC) requires one (01) Assistant Public Relations Officer on contract basis. Applications received after that time will be rejected.

15/12/2026, 3.00 PM (application must reach by this time)

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: Regional Cancer Centre (RCC) is a cancer centre in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, located at Medical College P.O., Thiruvananthapuram-695011. The notice was issued by its Director on 23 November 2026 and was addressed to the RCC Notice Board and the RCC Website. The centre's phone number printed on the notice is 0471-2522278.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, which candidates may download from the RCC Website ( www.rcctvm.gov.in ). The completed application has to reach this address latest by 3.00 PM on 15 December 2026: The Director, Regional Cancer Centre, Medical College P.O., Thiruvananthapuram-695011, Kerala, India Download the application form from the RCC Website ( www.rcctvm.gov.in ). Fill in the application form and sign it. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. Send the application to the Director at the address above so that it reaches by 3.00 PM on 15 December 2026. The deadline is for receipt at RCC, not for dispatch. The postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) and any text to write on the envelope are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Assistant Public Relations Officer, engaged on contract basis in Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram. Bachelors Degree in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized University or National Institute. Masters Degree in Public Relations/ Journalism from a recognized University or Institute. Three years of experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role in public relations/publicity, printing, publishing. All three are essential conditions. Applicants not possessing these essential qualifications will be rejected without any notice. The age limit is not exceeding 40 years as on 01/01/2026. Relaxation of the upper age limit will be given to SC/ST and OBC candidates as per existing norms; the notice does not print the number of years of relaxation. The initial contract period will be for one year on the monthly remuneration of ₹ 40,000/-, which is extendable based on the performance if required. No allowances are mentioned in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents must accompany the signed application form: Proof of age Proof of Qualification & Experience CV/Bio data Recent passport size photograph

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Assistant Public Relations Officer at Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram, on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Director, Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram latest by 3.00 PM on 15 December 2026; applications received later will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelors Degree in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks, a Masters Degree in Public Relations/ Journalism, and three years of experience including at least 2 years in a supervisory role in public relations/publicity, printing, publishing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 40 years as on 01/01/2026, with relaxation of the upper age limit for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per existing norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer?
faq.answer: The post carries a monthly remuneration of ₹ 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application from www.rcctvm.gov.in, fill in and sign it, affix a recent passport size photograph, attach the self-attested documents and send it to The Director, Regional Cancer Centre, Medical College P.O., Thiruvananthapuram-695011, Kerala, India.

faq.question: Q7. Is the RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract basis; the initial contract period is one year, extendable based on performance if required.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be enclosed with the RCC application?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of proof of age, proof of qualification and experience, CV/Bio data and a recent passport size photograph must be enclosed.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets age relaxation for the RCC Assistant Public Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: SC/ST and OBC candidates get relaxation of the upper age limit as per existing norms.
